deployments_detail.use: Widespread adoption of ChatGPT Enterprise plus 240+ custom GPTs (via a cross-functional 'GPT Lab') for employees to browse ELC's data vault of clinical trials and consumer surveys, run fragrance category analysis, and develop/market new products across all brands. [OpenAI (ChatGPT Enterprise / custom GPTs)]

ConsumerIQ, an AI agent that acts as a centralized intelligence hub letting employees query decades of consumer data (across 25 brands, 150 countries) in natural language and get citation-backed insights; used by Origins, Estée Lauder and other brand teams. [Microsoft Copilot Studio + Azure OpenAI Service]
deployments_detail.value: Data-gathering time cut from weeks to minutes

deployments_detail.use: Voice-enabled Makeup Assistant (VMA), an AI/AR iOS and Android app that analyzes makeup on a user's face and gives audio feedback on evenness/coverage of foundation, eyeshadow and lipstick to help visually impaired users apply makeup independently. [Estée Lauder (proprietary AI/AR)]

ELLA (Estée Lauder Language Assistant), an internal generative-AI tool built on Google Cloud AI, plus AI-powered personalization of digital commerce and real-time monitoring of consumer sentiment/feedback. [Google Cloud (Gemini / generative AI)]

AI-powered inventory deployment system being developed to anticipate global demand shifts, reposition stock, reduce distribution friction, and align demand and supply as part of enterprise-wide supply chain optimization (built on IBP process and factory digital twins). [none]

Trend Studio, an AI agent that detects market trends, recommends products, generates tailored marketing copy, and integrates Virtual Try-On to visualize products for consumer marketing and trend forecasting. [Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service + Azure AI Search]

Adopting Adobe Firefly Services and Adobe Experience Manager Assets to scale production of digital marketing content — automating asset resizing/reformatting and DAM search; M·A·C Cosmetics was the first ELC brand to pilot the technology. [Adobe Firefly Services / Adobe Experience Manager]

AI-powered Scent Advisor for Jo Malone London — a conversational AI experience that interprets customer scent descriptions and maps them to fragrance attributes to recreate the in-store consultation online (live on JoMalone.com in US and UK). [Google Cloud (Gemini + Vertex AI)]
deployments_detail.value: Users of the tool had double the purchase rate of non-users (per WSJ)

deployments_detail.use: AI-driven augmented-reality virtual try-on for makeup (Lip Virtual Try-On, iMatch Virtual Shade Expert foundation matching) deployed online and in-store, plus AR training for beauty advisors. [Perfect Corp (YouCam Makeup)]
deployments_detail.value: 2.5x higher conversion online; 8,000+ in-store devices across 45 markets; iMatch uses 89,969 skin-tone database

deployments_detail.use: 240 custom GPTs (OpenAI + Azure OpenAI) for product dev, trend forecasting, consumer marketing; M365 Copilot
